# Norma Hana Core (nh-core)

> Site-specific WordPress plugin for Norma Hana Slow Fashion Atelier (Santa Marta, Colombia).
> Namespace: NormaHana\Core\ (PSR-4)

## Key Specs
- PHP: >= 8.0
- Architecture: PSR-4 Modular, Service Providers, Repositories, Hook Subscribers.
- Core Table: `wp_nh_communication_preferences` (Customer Preferences & Habeas Data Ley 1581).
- REST API: `GET|POST /wp-json/nh/v1/preferences` (Header: `X-NH-API-Key: nh_telegram_bot_sec_2026_x871a`).
- Security: HMAC-SHA256 tokens (`hash_hmac`), constant-time validation (`hash_equals`).
- Analytics: Google Consent Mode v2 `granted` default (`-10002` priority in `wp_head`).
- E-Commerce: WooCommerce HPOS (`wp_wc_orders`), CartFlows email interceptor.
- VPS Deploy: `rsync -avz --exclude '.git' ./ root@2.25.85.177:/docker/normahana/html/wp-content/plugins/nh-core/`
- OPcache Flush: `docker exec normahana-php-1 wp eval 'opcache_reset();' --allow-root`

## File Map
- `nh-core.php`: Plugin entry point & PSR-4 autoloader.
- `src/Plugin.php`: Kernel bootstrapper singleton.
- `src/Common/`: Interfaces (`ServiceProviderInterface`, `HookSubscriberInterface`).
- `src/Modules/Preferences/`: Database repository, token service, REST controller, frontend hooks, service provider.
- `src/Modules/Tracking/`: Consent mode v2, dataLayer events.
- `src/Modules/ECommerce/`: HPOS order helper, CartFlows interceptor.
- `src/Modules/Integrations/`: n8n webhooks, Phosphor icons.
- `AGENTS.md`: Full technical specifications and guardrails.
